title: Hold a stock route travel permit to drive stock
what: Drive stock on foot on stock routes and other relevant land only under a stock route travel permit from the local government, unless the movement is exempt.

sources.title: Stock Route Management Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: Subject to section 133 , a person must not drive stock on foot on relevant land in a local government’s area unless a local government has issued a permit (a stock route travel permit ) for the stock movement
